description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer vertical-scroll checkpoint: safe Rust owns viewport/DEC-margin SU, SD, IL, DL and RI movement, cursor side effects, horizontal-margin clipping and standard-erase attributes including 16/256/RGB color preservation.

entries.notes: Safe Rust composes the overlap-safe rectangular mover with viewport vertical bounds for SU/SD/IL/DL/RI magnitudes, preserving rows outside the viewport and standard-erasing revealed cells.
SU moves only the DEC vertical region and, when DECLRMM is active, only the horizontal margin columns; surrounding cells remain untouched.
SD mirrors SU downward with the same vertical/horizontal clipping and standard-erase fill.
IL scrolls the cursor-to-bottom portion down, clips to active horizontal margins and returns the cursor to the active left margin.
DL scrolls the cursor-to-bottom portion up, clips to active horizontal margins and returns the cursor to the active left margin.
RI moves the cursor upward away from the top margin and scrolls the active region downward without moving the cursor when already on the top margin.
IL/DL/RI clear revealed rows with standard-erase active attributes while preserving indexed-16, indexed-256 and RGB background colors.
